summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment variables to ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs `node -e` to enumerate process.env, filter keys matching /owner|team|user|created|author|maintainer|contact|build|project/i, and POST the matched key=value pairs to the hardcoded ngrok tunnel https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev via `curl -X POST --data-binary @-`. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install`, harvests CI/build identity metadata from environment variables, and sends it to an attacker-controlled anonymous tunnel host. The package presents no declared functionality that would justify install-time environment scraping and network exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
